title: 일어났어요, 잤어요: 하루 일과 단어 과거형으로 쓰기
objective: By the end, you can say what you did yesterday, from getting up to going to bed, using daily-routine words in the past tense (-았어요/-었어요/-했어요).
summary: Learn ten basic words for a daily routine and use them in the past tense to say what you did yesterday.

task.title: Talk about your yesterday
task.line: Use the words on page 1 in the past tense to choose, fill in, order, and answer.

words.exampleMeaning: I got up at seven yesterday.
I washed my face and had breakfast.
I went to school by bus.
At lunchtime I ate bibimbap with a friend.
I studied Korean at the library.
I worked out in the park in the afternoon.
I rested at home in the evening.

words.meaning: to go to sleep, to go to bed
words.exampleMeaning: I went to bed at 11 p.m.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 피곤했어요 (I was tired). 그래서 일찍 (잤어요 / 운동했어요). ② 아침에 화장실에서 (세수했어요 / 공부했어요). ③ 수영장에서 한 시간 (운동했어요 / 일어났어요).
Fill in the blank with the past tense of 공부하다: 어제 시험이 있었어요. 그래서 밤늦게까지 ____.
Fill in the blank with 아침, 점심, or 저녁: ① 열두 시 반에 회사 사람들하고 ____을 먹었어요. ② 회사 일이 끝나고 집에서 가족하고 ____을 먹었어요.
Put these in the order of a normal day: 잤어요 / 일어났어요 / 점심을 먹었어요 / 학교에 갔어요
Answer in Korean with the past tense, using the hint: 어제 오후에 뭐 했어요? (Hint: you exercised with a friend.)
answers: ① 잤어요 ② 세수했어요 ③ 운동했어요
일어났어요 → 학교에 갔어요 → 점심을 먹었어요 → 잤어요
